title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning Enforcement Settlement

articles.content_en:
Article 1 The parties may voluntarily negotiate and reach a settlement agreement to change, in accordance with law, the subject of rights and obligations, subject matter of performance, time limit, place and method, etc., as determined by the effective legal instrument.
The settlement agreement shall generally be in written form.
Article 3 After the suspension of enforcement, if the applicant for enforcement applies for the release of seizure, impoundment or freezing, the People's Court may permit it.
Article 4 Where an authorized agent executes a settlement agreement on behalf of a party, the principal shall grant special authorization.

Article 5 If the parties reach consensus through consultation, they may modify the settlement agreement for enforcement, and shall either submit the modified agreement to the People's Court, or have the enforcement personnel record the modified content in the transcript, which shall be signed or sealed by all parties.

Article 6 Where the parties reach an enforcement settlement agreement for debt satisfaction by property, the People's Court shall not render a ruling on debt satisfaction by property pursuant to such agreement.

Article 7 During the performance of the enforcement settlement agreement, if the circumstances specified in Article 101 of the Contract Law are met, the obligor may, in accordance with law, apply to the relevant authority for deposit; if the enforcement settlement agreement provides for the payment of money, the obligor may also apply to the enforcement court for deposit.
Article 8 Where the enforcement settlement agreement is fully performed, the People's Court shall handle it as a case closure of enforcement.

Article 9 If the party subject to enforcement fails to perform the enforcement settlement agreement, the applicant for enforcement may apply for the resumption of enforcement of the original effective legal instrument, or may initiate an action with the enforcement court regarding the performance of the enforcement settlement agreement.

Article 10 The provisions of Article 239 of the Civil Procedure Law on the time period for application for enforcement shall apply to the application for resumption of enforcement of the original effective legal instrument.
If a party fails to perform the enforcement settlement agreement, the time period for applying for resumption of enforcement shall be counted from the last day of the performance period stipulated in the enforcement settlement agreement.

Article 12 Any party or interested person that considers the resumption or non-resumption of enforcement to be in violation of legal provisions may raise an objection in accordance with Article 225 of the Civil Procedure Law.

Article 13 After the resumption of enforcement, the People's Court shall not accept any action filed by the applicant for enforcement regarding the performance of the enforcement settlement agreement.

Article 14 Where the applicant for enforcement initiates an action regarding the performance of the enforcement settlement agreement, after the enforcement court accepts the case, it may rule to terminate the enforcement of the original effective legal instrument. The measures of seizure, impoundment and freezing in enforcement shall automatically convert into preservative measures in litigation.

Article 15 After the enforcement settlement agreement is fully performed, if the applicant for enforcement suffers damage due to delayed performance or defective performance by the party subject to enforcement, it may separately initiate an action with the enforcement court.

Article 16 Any party or interested person that considers the enforcement settlement agreement to be void or subject to revocation may initiate an action with the enforcement court. After the enforcement settlement agreement is confirmed void or revoked, the applicant for enforcement may apply for resumption of enforcement on that basis.
If the party subject to enforcement initiates an action on the ground that the enforcement settlement agreement is void or subject to revocation, it shall not affect the applicant for enforcement's application for resumption of enforcement.

Article 17 After the resumption of enforcement, the portion already performed under the enforcement settlement agreement shall be deducted in accordance with law. Any party or interested person that considers the deduction by the People's Court to be in violation of legal provisions may raise an objection in accordance with Article 225 of the Civil Procedure Law.

Article 18 Where the enforcement settlement agreement contains a guarantee clause, and the guarantor undertakes to the People's Court that it voluntarily accepts direct compulsory enforcement if the party subject to enforcement fails to perform the enforcement settlement agreement, after the resumption of enforcement of the original effective legal instrument, the People's Court may, upon the application of the applicant for enforcement and in accordance with the guarantee clause, directly rule to enforce the guaranteed property or the property of the surety.

Article 20 These Provisions shall come into force as of March 1, 2018.
Where the judicial interpretations published by the Supreme People's Court before these Provisions come into force are inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.
